name: current_empresa_id
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_empresa_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select empresa_id from public.usuarios where id = auth.uid()
$function$
